requirements.name: The reason for importing decides which four further obligations apply

scenarios.name: Internal market asks only for the purpose

tests.test: asks the internal-market purpose under its own radio
tests.notes: asserts purpose radios in the reveal; destination/port/exit live under other reveals

tests.test: purpose is owed only for the internal market and is wiped when the reason changes
tests.notes: Internal market + purpose Breeding completes the row; Transit then asks exit fields instead

tests.test: is mandatory in-scope when reasonForImport is internalMarket

scenarios.name: Transit asks for the destination country and the port of exit

tests.test: asks transit for the port of exit and then the destination country
tests.notes: field ids exactly transitPortOfExit then transitDestinationCountry

tests.test: purpose is owed only for the internal market and is wiped when the reason changes
tests.notes: Transit: fills port of exit + destination country on the same submit

scenarios.name: Transhipment or onward travel asks only for the destination country

tests.test: asks transhipment for the destination country alone

scenarios.name: Temporary admission of horses asks for the port of exit and the exit date

tests.test: asks temporary admission for the exit date and then the port of exit
saves an exit date chosen from the picker inside the reveal, and offers it back

scenarios.name: Any other reason asks for none of the four

tests.test: opens no reveal until a reason that needs one is chosen
tests.notes: reEntry keeps transit reveal hidden and has no aria-controls

tests.test: is out of scope when reasonForImport is absent
tests.notes: purpose out of scope on empty; not every 'other' reason enumerated in one test

requirements.name: Changing the reason discards the answers the previous reason called for

scenarios.name: Changing the reason away and back asks the question afresh

tests.test: purpose is owed only for the internal market and is wiped when the reason changes
tests.notes: Internal market → Transit → Internal market: purpose radios unchecked

tests.test: Should drop the answers of the reason the user moved away from
tests.notes: transit exit fields cleared when flipping to internalMarket

tests.test: purges stored purpose when reasonForImport flips away from internalMarket

scenarios.notes: No FIT wipe round-trip; fit only persists a chosen reason's own reveal.
